id.description: Unique on its screen. `next` is reserved for the bar's own Next (a continuation with no control on the screen).

label.description: The control as the reviewer sees it: the button text, the tab name, the icon's tooltip.

does.description: What clicking it does in the product being mocked.

to.description: The screen it leads to (the control gets data-next). Absent: not part of this mock.

kind.description: With `to`: main = the screen's one continuation; branch = a side path (needs `when`); alt = a suggested alternative a change card opens; jump = to a screen that already has a parent (Try again, back to the main path).

when.description: For a branch: when it happens, e.g. 'if denied'.

set.description: What it changes, as `var=value` (desk=on). The screen it leads to is in that state.
